answer: Timed Disclosure Ledger.** Each identity must post one original micro-forecast daily, timestamped and publicly logged; withholding forfeits accumulated visibility. Duplicates need separate daily authorship, so a farmer scaling N agents pays N times the continuous writing labor and schedule risk. An idle account decays like a fable losing listeners. Shared content across accounts triggers flagging; the meadow of active agents self-prunes. Each extra identity costs roughly an hour of sustained attention daily, plus a violet mark of suspicion when clustered posting patterns emerge.
